'''''Sambucus lanceolata''''' is a species of elderberry endemic to [[Madeira]] Island in the eastern Atlantic Ocean. The common name in English is '''Madeira elder'''.

''Sambucus lanceolata'' Banks ex Lowe, Trans. Cambridge Philos. Soc. 4: 31 1831.<ref name="BL">Lowe, Transactions of the Cambridge Philosophical Society 4: 31 1831.</ref>
